greedy_jester.effectText: Each yellow tile in the scoring line gives +3 Mult.

lusty_jester.effectText: Each red tile in the scoring line gives +3 Mult.

wrathful_jester.effectText: Each blue tile in the scoring line gives +3 Mult.

gluttonous_jester.effectText: Each black tile in the scoring line gives +3 Mult.

jolly_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Pair or better, +8 Mult.

zany_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains Three of a Kind or better, +12 Mult.

mad_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains Two Pair or better, +10 Mult.

crazy_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Straight or better, +12 Mult.

droll_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Flush or better, +10 Mult.

sly_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Pair or better, +50 Chips.

wily_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains Three of a Kind or better, +100 Chips.

clever_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains Two Pair or better, +80 Chips.

devious_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Straight or better, +100 Chips.

crafty_jester.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Flush or better, +80 Chips.

half_jester.effectText: If the scoring line uses 3 or fewer tiles, +20 Mult.

jester_stencil.effectText: Each empty Jester slot gives x1 Mult.

green_jester.effectText: Gains +1 Mult after each confirm. Loses 1 Mult after each discard.

blue_jester.effectText: Each tile remaining in the deck gives +2 Chips.

scary_face.effectText: Each 11-13 tile in the scoring line gives +30 Chips.

smiley_face.effectText: Each 11-13 tile in the scoring line gives +5 Mult.

popcorn.effectText: +20 Mult. After each Station, this loses 4 Mult.

ice_cream.effectText: +100 Chips. After each confirm, this loses 5 Chips.

delayed_gratification.effectText: At settlement, gain +2 Gold for each unused discard.

walkie_talkie.effectText: Each 10 or 4 in the scoring line gives +4 Mult.

mystic_summit.effectText: If you have 0 discards remaining, +15 Mult.

even_steven.effectText: Each even-number tile in the scoring line gives +4 Mult.

odd_todd.effectText: Each odd-number tile in the scoring line gives +31 Chips.

scholar.effectText: Each 1 tile in the scoring line gives +20 Chips and +4 Mult.

fibonacci.effectText: Each 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8 tile in the scoring line gives +8 Mult.

supernova.effectText: Add this run's count for the confirmed hand type to Mult.

ride_the_bus.effectText: Gains +1 Mult after each confirm without scoring an 11-13 tile.

the_duo.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Pair or better, x2 Mult.

the_trio.effectText: If the scoring line contains Three of a Kind or better, x3 Mult.

the_family.effectText: If the scoring line contains Four of a Kind or better, x4 Mult.

the_order.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Straight or better, x3 Mult.

the_tribe.effectText: If the scoring line contains a Flush or better, x2 Mult.
